home.title: A verified reference corpus
home.description: Every claim traces to official docs, framework source, or a measurement someone ran. Code is extracted from demos that build, not typed into a code fence. CI fails when the two drift apart.
home.thesis: Every claim traces to official docs, framework source, or a measurement someone ran. Code is extracted from demos that build, not typed into a code fence. CI fails when the two drift apart.
home.graphCaption: Cross-links among the four corpora, cropped to the corpus level.
home.entryCourseBody: Twelve articles in reading order, concepts alternating with the recipes that exercise them.
home.entryBrowseBody: Grouped by repository and concept folder. No chronology, because there is none.
home.entryGraphBody: {count} cross-links across four corpora, drawn as one graph.
home.readingConcept: Explains a mechanism. Read when you want to know how something works before it breaks.
home.readingRecipe: Starts from a symptom you have already seen, and works back to the mechanism.
home.readingBaseline: The framework version every claim in an article was verified against. Claims are pinned, never floating.
home.readingProvenance: Code blocks name the demo file they were extracted from. Nothing is typed by hand into an article.
